7.10.1 Read DTC
The J1939-73 [14] standard defines various DM messages to report DTC information.
The differences among these DM messages is mostly due to different filters on DTC
states, such as active or pending DTCs, or on the OBD DTC class. The Dem provides
a uniform way to read out the stored DTC information for these messages. The se-
quence diagram in figure 9.9 shows the general approach to retrieving the J1939 DTC
information. The reporting content for different J1939 DM messages is accessed by
using different input filter parameters.
[SWS_Dem_00855]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈The function Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter shall set the filter mask attributes to be
used for the subsequent calls of Dem_J1939DcmGetNumberOfFilteredDTC and
Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredDTC, and reset an internal counter to the first
event.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00856]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈The filter mask attributes set via Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter shall be used until
the next call of Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter or Dem initialization.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00857] ⌈The function Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter shall return the
current composite status of the J1939 lamps. The matching filter criteria are defined in

Each reading of DTC returns a composite lamp status of the following lamps:

b) Red Stop Lamp
c) Amber Warning Lamp
d) Protect Lamp
